codeLivewirePhp:
<?php
namespace App\Livewire;

use Illuminate\View\View;
use Livewire\Attributes\Locked;
use Livewire\Component;

class SlaPriorityQueue extends Component
{
    #[Locked]
    public array $rows = [
        ['ref' => 1042, 'title' => 'VPN drops every 10 minutes', 'priority' => 'Critical', 'remaining' => -30, 'window' => 240, 'owner' => 'Alex Rivera'],
        ['ref' => 1043, 'title' => 'Printer on floor 2 shows paper jam', 'priority' => 'High', 'remaining' => 75, 'window' => 480, 'owner' => 'Unassigned'],
        ['ref' => 1044, 'title' => 'New starter laptop setup', 'priority' => 'Medium', 'remaining' => 240, 'window' => 1440, 'owner' => 'Sam Okafor'],
        ['ref' => 1048, 'title' => 'Disk at 96% on file server', 'priority' => 'Critical', 'remaining' => 80, 'window' => 240, 'owner' => 'Alex Rivera'],
    ];
    public string $search = '';
    public array $selected = [];
    public string $notice = '';

    public function updatedSearch(): void
    {
        $this->selected = [];
    }

    public function assign(): void
    {
        $refs = array_intersect(array_map('intval', $this->selected), array_column($this->rows, 'ref'));
        $count = count(array_unique($refs));
        foreach ($this->rows as &$row) {
            if (in_array($row['ref'], $refs, true)) {
                $row['owner'] = 'Alex Rivera';
            }
        }
        unset($row);
        $this->selected = [];
        $this->notice = 'Assigned '.$count.' request'.($count === 1 ? '' : 's').' to Alex Rivera.';
    }

    public function render(): View
    {
        $term = mb_strtolower(trim($this->search));
        $visible = array_filter($this->rows, static fn (array $r): bool => str_contains(
            mb_strtolower(implode(' ', [$r['ref'], $r['title'], $r['owner'], $r['priority']])), $term
        ));
        $rank = static fn (array $r): array => [
            $r['remaining'] < 0 ? 0 : ($r['remaining'] < 120 ? 1 : 2),
            $r['remaining'], array_search($r['priority'], ['Critical', 'High', 'Medium', 'Low'], true), $r['ref'],
        ];
        usort($visible, static fn (array $a, array $b): int => $rank($a) <=> $rank($b));
        return view('livewire.sla-priority-queue', compact('visible'));
    }
}
